title: Punch Bowl Social
venue_description:
About Punch Bowl Social

Premier entertainment destination combining dining and entertainment. Features two full-service bars downstairs and one upstairs in open-air town center location.

Music and Entertainment

Weekly music bingo Saturdays 1-3 PM. First Friday karaoke with DJ LU 9 PM-midnight featuring open mic style experience. After Dark nights Friday and Saturday with DJs and themed nights including 90s R&B and Latin hits from 9:30 PM.

Facilities

Fourteen bowling lanes with shoe rentals. Ping pong and extensive arcade upstairs. Private karaoke rooms available. Casual bar areas throughout.

Food and Beverage

Shareable food items and craft beverages. Full service bars with cocktails and beer. American casual dining. Kids menu available. Family friendly until 10 PM then 21+.

Atmosphere

Upbeat playful casual venue described as buzzy with music games and group energy. Perfect for celebrations and group outings.
location: 12635 North Main Street Rancho Cucamonga CA 91739

title: The Arrow Room
venue_description:
The Arrow Room - Independent Music Venue

Brand new independent music venue opened 2026 inside Haven City Market. Designed with intention and engineered for clarity offering focused environment for artists and audiences.

Venue Philosophy

Serves critical role in Inland Empire music scene providing space where artists can succeed without leaving region. Creates opportunities for emerging and established artists in intimate setting.

Music and Entertainment

Hosts live music featuring rock alternative metal and tribute bands. Rock tribute nights with classics from various eras including 80s hair metal punk and modern rock. Diverse programming from classic rock to contemporary acts.

Venue Features

Intentionally small intimate atmosphere. Standing area front of stage and first come first served table seating. Excellent sound quality and professional acoustics. General admission format.

Amenities

Located inside Haven City Market with free parking. Full bar 21+. All ages during daytime. Phone cameras allowed. Wheelchair accessible. Represents future of Inland Empire live music culture.
location: 8443 Haven Avenue Unit 101 Rancho Cucamonga CA 91730

title: Lewis Family Playhouse
venue_description:
Lewis Family Playhouse

Professional performing arts venue hosting live entertainment including concerts theatrical productions and special performances.

Performance and Events

Regularly hosts live music featuring diverse genres including tributes classical and contemporary artists. Recent performances include Steamroller James Taylor Tribute and Mariachi Divas de Cindy Shea. Presents regional and touring acts with professional quality.

Venue Features

Excellent acoustics and comfortable seating arranged for optimal viewing. Professional stage with full lighting and sound capabilities. Accommodates various performance types from solo to full orchestras.

Theater Type

Professional theater space serving as cultural center for community. Hosts ballet performances theatrical productions and special events. Family friendly welcoming all ages.

Location

Conveniently located in Rancho Cucamonga accessible to residents throughout Inland Empire. Continues developing programming to serve community entertainment needs.

title: Epic Events Center
venue_description:
Epic Events Center

Full-service event venue hosting live music performances special events and entertainment experiences.

Music and Entertainment

Features live music emphasizing jazz funk soul and R&B. A Soulful and Saxy Night showcases saxophone players and jazz musicians. Hosts touring acts and local performers with diverse musical experiences.

Venue Features

Professional stage with full sound system and lighting. Full bar service available. Dining options at venue. Accommodates various group sizes from intimate to larger events.

Event Types

Hosts concerts live music shows tributes and special entertainment events. Serves local community and regional needs as professional entertainment destination.
